test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pandit Birju Maharaj was related to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kathak is the **classical dance of Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• **Brijmohan Mishra **is popularly known as Pandit Birju Maharaj.
 
• Birju Maharaj was honored with the country's second-highest Civilian Award, **Padma Vibhushan in 1986** for his remarkable contribution. 
 
• In 2012, Pandit Birju Maharaj won the** ‘Best Choreography’ **category National Award for **Vishwaroopam**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Exponents of Kathak** are Shrimati Prerana Shrimala, Uma Sharma, Maya Rao, Rani Karnaa, and Rajendra Gangani.
 
• The **Ozele dance** is a traditional dance performed by the **Wancho tribe of Arunachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• The **Tapu War dance** is a traditional dance of the **Adi Tribe in Arunachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• **Exponents of Odissi** dance Kelucharan Mohapatra, Pankaj Charan Das, Deba Prasad Das, Raghunath Dutta.
 
• Other dances of Arunachal Pradesh are Buiya, Chalo, Wancho, Pasi Kongki, Ponung, and Popir.
